description: This file defines a command-line interface (CLI) for managing Matrix accounts, profiles, direct rooms, device verification, and backup operations. It includes functions for adding accounts, setting profiles, inspecting and repairing direct rooms, checking verification status, and managing backups, with commands registered via the 'commander' library.

methods.description: Resets internal CLI state for testing purposes.

methods.name: scheduleMatrixCliExit
methods.description: Schedules process exit after command execution, with a timeout to allow async work to complete.

methods.description: Sets process exit code to 1 to indicate failure.
